rules.relevant_items: Instances (Date/User/Instance lines of the public context) in the question's subset: 'in <Month> of any year', 'between <d0> and <d1>, inclusive', 'user IDs <n>', 'User <a> or User <b>'; otherwise all instances.
rules.items_displayed: A relevant instance counts as displayed when a 56-character window of its text (characters 4-60, or the last 60-4 for texts of 200+ characters) appears in a root tool result; texts of 12-63 characters match on text[4:]; texts under 12 characters cannot be matched and are left out of the coverage denominator (count reported).
rules.label_rule: A regex literal (Clojure #"...", Python re.* argument) with >=3 alternation branches, none naming Date/User/Instance/month/\d structure; or a vector/list of >=5 quoted alphabetic keywords (not month names). Single-label probes are not rules.
rules.judgement_literal: Model judgements written into code: >=8 integers in one literal run (index sets), or a quoted string of >=10 letters drawn from <=3 symbols (e.g. 'TFTF...').
rules.per_batch_count: A number appended to program state per page: x.append(<int>[+<int>]), x=[<int>], or Clojure swap!/conj with an integer.
rules.decision_count: A non-final call with a counting operation (len/sum/count/frequencies/Counter/distinct) whose short (<300 char) result has digits, over a judgement literal, a label rule, or a variable defined from one.
rules.algorithm_class: delegated: child sessions exist. structural-only: question has no 'label' and no label rule. R = label rule present; J = judgement literal present or >= min(20, relevant) items displayed. R and not J: rules. R and J: rules if no judgement literal and the last non-final call holds the rule (rule decided after a look), else mixed. J only: read-and-judge.
rules.answer_basis: From the last decision_count, if no new items were displayed after it: computed-from-judgements (over judgement literals), computed-from-rules (over a rule only), computed-sum-of-stated-batch-counts (over per-batch numbers only). computed-structural: no labels needed. stated: no decision_count, so the count lived only in thinking/text; 'stated (code counts preceded further reading)' when the last decision_count came before more items were read. For numeric tasks also: does the final number appear in a short (<300 char) root tool result.
rules.verification: reread-selected: a call after the first item display that prints items chosen by an explicit index list or single index. label-length-check: len/count of a judgement literal by itself. recount: a second decision_count with no new items displayed since the previous one. after_pass marks calls after the last call that displayed new items.
rules.errors: Aljure: tool-result status != ok. Prime: toolResult isError, status != ok, or a traceback; assistant stopReason 'error'. Recovered: a later successful tool result in the same session.
rules.text_candidates: Text-only replies (Aljure rejections; Prime replies when no answer file exists). The last requested-form line in each is scored with the official scorer, as the counterfactual 'if this text had been accepted'.
rules.child_use: Prime: numbers in agent_message replies from children that reappear inside the root's per-batch count expressions (e.g. C.append(11+22)).
rules.end_reason: model-finished: Aljure session complete via done, or Prime root ended its own turn. harness-rejection: Aljure session failed on a rejected response. limit: calls, seconds or dollars reached the plan cap.
